description: This file defines the class 'actionComputeField', which extends 'actionBase'. It implements functionality for computing and updating fields within the SuiteCRM platform, including interpreting formulas, handling relation parameters, and rendering UI components for configuration. It is part of the module 'AOW_Actions' and contains methods for executing formulas, resolving parameters, and generating dynamic HTML and JavaScript for admin/config UI.

classes.name: actionComputeField
classes.description: Represents a custom action in SuiteCRM for computing fields based on formulas and related data, with capabilities for rendering configuration UI and executing computations on beans.

methods.name: loadJS
methods.description: Returns an array of JavaScript files required for client-side logic associated with this action.

methods.name: run_action
methods.description: Executes the formula calculations and updates the bean's fields accordingly, saving changes if necessary.

methods.name: edit_display
methods.description: Generates HTML and JavaScript for the configuration UI to specify parameters, relations, and formulas.

methods.name: getModuleFieldsDropdown
methods.description: Creates an HTML options string listing fields of the given bean's module, including their data types.

methods.name: getOneRelationOptions
methods.description: Builds a selection dropdown of relation options (related modules/fields) for configuration.

methods.name: getOneRelations
methods.description: Returns an array of 'one' type relationship definitions for the given bean.

methods.name: getRelationDefinitions
methods.description: Retrieves relationship definition details for a specified relation.

methods.name: getOppositeModule
methods.description: Determines the opposite module in a relationship based on the definition.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Utility to translate labels, with fallback logic for module-specific and general translations.

methods.name: getRelationParameterFieldSelect
methods.description: Generates an HTML select element for relation parameter fields.

methods.name: createOptions
methods.description: Sorts and creates HTML options for relation selections based on module and relation name.

methods.name: createJavascriptArrayFromParams
methods.description: Converts PHP parameter arrays into JavaScript array syntax for UI scripts.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Builds an HTML option element for a relation.

methods.name: getOtherModuleForRelationship
methods.description: Queries the database to determine the related module for a relationship name.
